title: The Ninety-Year Soup (Part 2)
description: Darnell went down to the basement to inspect the perpetual pot, live on air, and never finished reading the 1934 ingredient list. Now the whole town has turned out, ladles in hand, more loyal to the soup than to the man condemning it, and the broth is still keeping its own temperature.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Welcome back to Snazzie FM. When we left off, our new health inspector had gone down to the basement to meet the pot in person. <p:0.3> Darnell, you still with us?

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: So, for the record... I'm still down here. <p:0.3> And there are now forty people in this basement. <p:0.3> All of them brought a ladle.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Forty? <p:0.3> Why would forty people bring forty ladles to a basement at night?

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Because you do not let a man inspect a Founder alone, dear. <p:0.3> That would be rude.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now that's community. The whole town, gathered around the pride of the town.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: It's not gathered around me, Ronnie. <p:0.3> It's gathered around the pot. <p:0.3> They keep stepping between me and it. Gently. Like a wall.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: I brought the carrots! <p:0.3> Fresh, peeled, Sunday carrots! So nobody can say the carrots weren't represented!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Patricia, nobody is voting on the carrots.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Actually, ma'am, please put the carrots down. <p:0.3> Every time you add one, the level in the pot does not go up. <p:0.3> It goes down.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Down? <p:0.3> You add to it and it gets... smaller?

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: It takes what it needs, dear. It always has. <p:0.3> That's why we keep adding.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: So, for the record, I finally found line four on the original list. <p:0.3> I told you it just said the word us. <p:0.3> Well, somebody crossed out us, and wrote, in fresher ink, the word you.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Line four says YOU?! <p:0.3> In FRESH ink?!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now that's a living document, Barry. A recipe that updates itself. <p:0.3> You can't buy that kind of freshness.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: I did NOT write that! <p:0.3> I only ever write carrots! Carrots is the only word I bring!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Nobody's hand is moving, ma'am. <p:0.3> The pen is on the floor. <p:0.3> The ink is wet and the pen is on the floor.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: It writes its own list now, dear. <p:0.3> It learned that around the nineties too.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Stop saying it LEARNED, Mildred! Soup does not pick up a PEN!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: I am formally condemning this pot! <p:0.3> Right now! On the record! Everybody step back from the...

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: It does not like the word condemn either, dear.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Carrots!

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Founder!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Darnell, GET UP THE STAIRS!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: The stairs are full of people! <p:0.3> They're not blocking me, they're just... ladling! Why is everyone calmly LADLING?!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Folks, the whole town is dipping in together. One big beautiful pot. <p:0.3> And the level just dropped again.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: So, for the record, it's quiet now. <p:0.3> And there's one more ladle than there was a man ago.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: A man AGO?! <p:0.3> Ronnie, did he just say a man ago?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Hear that, Barry? <p:0.5> One slow, satisfied bubble. <p:0.3> Almost like it cleared its plate.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: He's part of the foundation now, dear. <p:0.3> Welcome aboard, Darnell. <p:0.3> You don't turn off a Founder.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, line four doesn't say you anymore. <p:0.3> Somebody check what line FIVE says.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We'll find out after the break. <p:0.3> And if you're listening at home, the pot would love to meet you. <p:0.3> Bring a ladle. Soup's on.
